source.credit: AGFA-GEVAERT AG; original manufacturer measurements and graph content

apx400-density.conditions: Panel captioned 'Dichtekurve; Density curve' with no developer, time or densitometry stated. See film.development_note for what the sheet does let us conclude.

apx400-sensitivity.conditions: Panel captioned 'Spektrale Empfindlichkeit; Spectral sensitivity'. No density criterion, exposure time or processing is stated, unlike Kodak's sheets. Relative shape only.

film.name: Agfapan APX 400 (experimental)
film.development_note: The sheet does not label the density curve with a developer or time, and the sheet cannot place it. Measured average gradient is 0.530 over 1.3 decades and 0.548 over 1.5, from the point 0.1 above base. Every curve on the sheet's own gamma-time panel lies at or above about 0.55 across its whole plotted time range, so no developer and time on this datasheet produces the contrast the density panel shows. The conditions are therefore unknown and not inferable; 6 minutes, Refinal's recommended time, is recorded as a nominal label only.
film.base_density_note: Estimated asymptote just below the lowest plotted total density. The plotted left plateau averages 0.1574 and the lowest plotted point is 0.1570.
film.ceiling_note: Not measured. The plot stops at total density 2.36 at log exposure 2.0, still rising. 3.5 matches the ceiling assumed for the existing B&W preparations; the source does not measure this shoulder.
film.exposure_origin_note: Rendering convention: shift source exposure so net density 0.75 occurs at engine log exposure zero, matching the Double-X and Tri-X anchor. Not absolute ISO metering.
film.sensitivity_note: PCHIP of the single plotted log-sensitivity trace; engine covers 380-780 nm. The trace spans 379.97-664.93 nm and meets the panel's floor at 664.5 nm, so it is truncated at 660 nm. That truncation is an explicit unmeasured-tail approximation, not proof of zero red sensitivity.
film.density_tolerance_note: Set from the printed line, not borrowed: the density curve is stroked at 0.997 pt, which is 0.0284 D on this panel's scale, against 0.0156 D for the Kodak sheet behind the Tri-X preparation. 0.018 keeps the same fraction of the stroke width that preparation's 0.01 gate did. This is a graph-fitting tolerance, not an empirical accuracy claim.

print.note: Paired with the existing B&W paper preparation. Agfa published no paper pairing for this film; this is a rendering choice, not a manufacturer recommendation.

sampling.method: Constrained positive normal-CDF mixture, four mathematical components, fitting source points plus a 0.3-weight PCHIP/continuation prior. Shares scripts/bw_expansion/prepare.py's fit; components are mathematical, not measured emulsion layers.

authorship: New source extraction, preparation recipe and profile prepared with Claude for this repository, 2026-11-03.
